name: Modern Sticker
description: Clean contemporary illustration with bold shapes, crisp color, and polished shading.
prompt: Use a modern sticker illustration style: clean contemporary shapes, bold readable colors, crisp edges, and polished restrained shading. Keep the result expressive and immediately readable at Telegram sticker size.

name: 1950s Newspaper Cartoon
description: Mid-century newspaper cartoon ink, economical linework, and vintage halftone texture.
prompt: Use the style of a 1950s newspaper cartoon: expressive hand-inked linework, economical shapes, vintage print character, and restrained halftone texture. Make it feel authentically mid-century rather than digitally modern.

name: Advance Wars GBA
description: Colorful early-2000s handheld tactical-game character art with compact, readable forms.
prompt: Use the character-art style of Advance Wars on Game Boy Advance: colorful early-2000s handheld tactical-game illustration, confident anime-influenced outlines, compact readable forms, simple cel shading, and the visual limitations and charm of GBA-era artwork.

name: 1930s Rubber Hose
description: Playful black-and-white animation with bouncy limbs and vintage inked character design.
prompt: Use a classic 1930s rubber-hose animation style: playful hand-inked curves, bouncy expressive poses, simplified vintage character construction, and period-appropriate black-and-white cartoon rendering.

name: Medieval Woodcut
description: Carved black ink, dense hatching, and the rough character of an old printed woodblock.
prompt: Use a medieval woodcut print style: boldly carved black-ink contours, dense directional hatching, flattened period composition, and the tactile irregularity of an old hand-printed woodblock.

name: Victorian Engraving
description: Detailed nineteenth-century engraved linework with cross-hatching and antique print texture.
prompt: Use a nineteenth-century Victorian engraving style: precise etched contours, intricate cross-hatching, elegant antique print texture, and richly observed period detail.
